background.value: White background; must not have any pattern; no shadows on the background.

head_height.value: Face takes up 70%–80% of the photo, or 1.4"–1.6" (≈3.6–4.1cm) from the chin to the crown.

validity.value: No more than six months old, to ensure an up-to-date likeness.

file_spec.value: Digital photo 200 × 200 pixels (width × height); image file size 5–100 KB.

expression_restriction.value: Head must be square to the camera; face and eyes must be straight toward the camera (slight rotation/tilt is the condition to avoid).

ears_visibility.value: Both ears and cheeks must be clearly visible.

face_visibility.value: Photo shows only the applicant, no other persons (group pictures) or objects; face square to camera.

headwear_policy.value: Headwear is generally not permitted; exceptions possible for religious reasons, provided the face is visible from the lower tip of the chin to the forehead.

accessories.value: No other persons (group pictures) or objects may appear in the photo.

expression.en: Head must be square to the camera; face and eyes must be straight toward the camera.
expression.ko: 머리는 카메라를 정면으로 향해야 하며, 얼굴과 눈은 카메라를 똑바로 향해야 한다.
expression.ja: 頭はカメラに対して正面を向き、顔と目はカメラを真っ直ぐ向くこと。

ears.en: Both ears and cheeks must be clearly visible.
ears.ko: 양쪽 귀와 볼이 뚜렷이 보여야 한다.
ears.ja: 両耳と頬がはっきり見える必要がある。

face_visibility.en: Photo shows only the applicant — no other persons (group pictures) or objects.
face_visibility.ko: 사진에는 신청자 본인만 나와야 하며, 다른 사람(단체사진)이나 사물이 포함되어서는 안 된다.
face_visibility.ja: 写真には申請者本人のみが写ること。他の人物(集合写真)や物が写り込んではならない。

headwear.en: Headwear is generally not permitted; exceptions possible for religious reasons, provided the face is visible from the chin to the forehead.
headwear.ko: 머리가리개는 원칙적으로 금지되나, 종교적 사유의 경우 턱부터 이마까지 얼굴이 보이는 조건 하에 예외가 허용된다.
headwear.ja: 頭部covering(帽子等)は原則不可。宗教上の理由がある場合は、顎から額まで顔が見えることを条件に例外が認められる。

accessories.en: No other persons (group photos) or objects may appear in the photo.
accessories.ko: 사진에 다른 사람(단체사진)이나 사물이 포함되어서는 안 된다.
accessories.ja: 写真に他の人物(集合写真)や物が写り込んではならない。

db_conflicts.research_value: Digital upload is 200×200 pixels — a SQUARE (1:1) image — per Saudi Arabia's official eVisa portal, which does not match the DB's 4×6cm (2:3) rectangular ratio. The portal does not separately state a physical print size in cm.

No cm figure is directly published — specified as 70%–80% of the photo, or 1.4"–1.6" (≈3.6–4.1cm) chin-to-crown. The inch-derived upper bound (~4.1cm) slightly exceeds DB's stated upper bound (4.0cm).

cross_verification.note_en: visa.visitsaudi.com is Saudi Arabia's official eVisa/tourist-visa portal with a dedicated Photo Specifications page; content read directly. DB's headHeight (3.6–4.0cm) closely matches the source's stated 1.4"–1.6" (≈3.56–4.06cm) chin-to-crown range — effectively confirms headHeight. However DB's size field (4×6cm, rectangular) does not match the portal's stated 200×200px (square) digital-upload spec — flagged as db_conflict. Glasses policy and clothing restriction were not addressed on this specific page.
